claims.quote: Send in proof of identity , if needed.
claims.note: The application guide explicitly requests identity proof when needed.

claims.claim: Passport details can be used as identity proof
claims.quote: When you apply online, you’ll be asked to give valid passport details.
claims.note: Passport details are requested for an online application.

claims.quote: You’ll need your National Insurance number when you apply.
claims.note: Student Finance England says it is needed, but a general NI number page in the prompt says a student-loan applicant without one does not need one.
